dedupe_keys.name: copert calculation of emissions from road transport

description: COPERT is the EU standard calculator of emissions from road transport. Its development is coordinated by the European Environment Agency within the European Topic Centre on Air Pollution and Climate Change Mitigation, the European Commission's Joint Research Centre manages its scientific development, and the software site is run by Emisia. It uses vehicle population, mileage, speed and other data such as ambient temperature to calculate emissions and energy consumption for a country or region. Coverage: all main pollutants, greenhouse gases, air pollutants and toxic species, at national, regional or local scale and from annual to daily estimates; it was built for official inventories in EEA member countries and is used by many European countries for reporting. Its method is part of the EMEP/EEA air pollutant emission inventory guidebook, is peer reviewed under the UNECE LRTAP Convention and is consistent with the 2006 IPCC guidelines. Format and access: desktop software downloaded from the site, with a separate COPERT data offer. Licence and cost: terms could not be read because the download page needs JavaScript. Caveats: fleet-average factors, not link-level microsimulation. It can turn traffic volumes from network flow models into emissions for scenario and adaptation studies. It relates to HBEFA and the EEA noise data in the catalogue.
